recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source change is recommended unless the work group wants redundant editorial wording in the One Match bullet.
issue_request: FHIR-26845 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked the FHIR-core HTTP conditional create section to state that, for either No Matches or One Match, the server SHALL populate the response Location header.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-26845 was found. The Jira comment says the request had already been applied with FHIR-31965, and git history confirms f9b3cf00eec480a65fa6963c978a330ce2d57946 updated source/http.html to add create-like headers and body for the One Match case.
additional_context: FHIR-31965 is the same conditional-create response metadata family and is already represented on the combined branch by fb1b37f11fcf4e918578390e1d2c3b10282fffc3, which fixed the related transaction response example. FHIR-I minutes confirm both Jira dispositions, and Zulip discussion supports returning Location and related metadata on matched conditional creates.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source/http.html No matches bullet requires a Location header when a resource is created, and the One Match bullet requires headers and body populated as if a create had occurred, incorporating the create interaction's Location requirement.

related_jiras.note: Broader Published/Persuasive conditional-create response-metadata issue cited by FHIR-26845; it applied the One Match header/body wording and has already been reconciled on the combined branch.
